messages:
marie: FYI — partner delivered the new weights + tokenizer bundle for lyra-2-small. attaching initial notes and checksum mismatch on tokenizer. need quick intake triage and staging registry flow. who can take ownership?
ajay: I can pick this up. first step: verify checksums, signer, and put canonical copy into staging registry (read-only).
luca: +1. also want to run very-low-latency quant experiments (4-bit/8-bit) after provenance completed. i'll prepare a quant matrix.
artifact-bot: ingest event: s3://partner-drop/lyra2/lyra-2-small.tar.gz size=1.2G sha256=6f7a...c9a
marie: tokenizer file hash in the tarball doesn't match the manifest: expected sha256:a1b2...fff got sha256:dead...beef. could be packaging bug or a corrupted upload.
kai: tagging infra — do not run automated deploys against this artifact until we confirm signatures. recommend staging bucket with object-lock + access logs.
devon: quick check list from my side: 1) confirm original signer + sig file 2) recompute hashes locally 3) request re-upload if mismatch persists 4) verify tokenizer-vocab against tokenizer tests (roundtrip).
jordan: for the registry path, propose: gs://redwood-model-registry/staging/lyra-2-small/20260318/{weights.tar.gz, tokenizer.json, metadata.yaml, signatures/} and record provenance metadata in metadata.yaml: model_name, source_uri, release_tag, uploader, uploader_key_fingerprint, ingest_ts, checksum_map.
ajay: running local hash now. command: ```sha256sum lyra-2-small/tokenizer.json``` I'll attach output.
ajay: output: deadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeef  tokenizer.json
luca: cool — matches the tarball hash. so manifest is wrong. reach out to partner for corrected manifest and signature. meanwhile we should still put artifact into staging but mark as "manifest-mismatch" and not usable for QA.
marie: agree. ajay/luca — plan: 1) copy artifact to staging (object-lock + retention 30d) 2) calculate canonical hashes and upload our own manifest + gpg signature 3) create an ingest ticket with provenance metadata 4) kick off a guarded quant experiment job with flags: --no-prod --read-only-kvcache --quant-sweep=4,8.
ajay: done step 1 locally, uploading to staging now. using kms key redwood-ingest-2025 to encrypt at rest.
ingest-bot: upload success: gs://redwood-model-registry/staging/lyra-2-small/20260318/lyra-2-small.tar.gz (etag: xyz123)
ajay: created our manifest (canonical_manifest.yaml) and signed with key fingerprint 7C:9A:12:34:56:78. storing signature at signatures/manifest.sig
devon: for quant experiments, use this minimal test harness: ```python -m quant_eval --model-path /staging/lyra-2-small --benchsets superglue,squad --bsz 1 --seq 512 --quant 4,8 --seed 42``` capture perf + accuracy and attach to the ingest ticket.
luca: will prepare baseline fp16 numbers first. also need to run tokenizer roundtrip: ```python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json'); print(t.encode('hello world').tokens)"```
marie: partner outreach note: @partner-ops — please regenerate manifest and include detached signature. include uploader GPG/PGP key fingerprint and optional SRI (sha256) for each file.
ajay: created ingest ticket ML-INTAKE-4827 with links + artifacts + manifest + signature + initial quant job scheduled (guarded).
marie: blocker check — anything preventing onboarding?
jordan: we need an SLO decision for this model (latency target) before promoting to dedicated. suggest: 50ms p95 token on n1-standard with A100 preemptible for benching.
kai: security sign-off pending KMS audit (will take 24h).
devon: QA: once partner fixes manifest we'll run the full eval suite and a diff against previous lyra-1 baselines. if accuracy delta > 1.5% we flag a regression alert.
luca: adding a small quant note: some ops in model use rotary embeddings — may require custom kernel for 4-bit. flagging to eng-runtime.
marie: thanks team. owner: ajay (artifact ingestion + registry), luca (quant experiments + benchmarks), devon (QA + regressions), jordan (metadata & SLOs), kai (sec/KMS). i'll update intake board and close this thread when partner provides corrected manifest and we have baseline numbers. :white_check_mark:
